name: mergeflow-sorter
description: G1 Mini-Project: Merge Sort & Recursion Tree Method - File/Log Sorter Tool

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(!fs.existsSync('public')) fs.mkdirSync('public'); ['index.html','sample_movies.csv','sample_server.log','sample_products.csv','pdf_example.txt','sample_large_logs.log','COLLEGE_MINI_PROJECT_REPORT.pdf','DEMO_AND_VIVA_GUIDE.pdf','FINAL_CHANGE_SUMMARY.pdf'].forEach(f=>{if(fs.existsSync(f))fs.copyFileSync(f,'public/'+f);}); console.log('Build complete - public directory populated');"
